name: DynamicToken_PhishingLoader
pattern:
rule Phishing_JavaScript_Dynamic_Link {
    meta:
        description = "Detects JavaScript generating phishing URLs with Microsoft impersonation"
        author = "Ahmed Mamdouh"
        date = "2024-06-20"
        reference = "Internal"
        severity = "High"

    strings:
        $func_header = "const generateSecureToken = (length) => {"
        $crypto_ref1 = "window.crypto || window.msCrypto"
        $crypto_ref2 = "new Uint32Array(length)"
        $charset = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghjkmnpqrstuvwxyz23456789"
        $return_logic = "return Array.from(values, v => chars[v % chars.length]).join('')"

    condition:
        all of them
}
